# Pinned upstream license evidence

These texts fill repository-level license/notice omissions in six pinned Cargo crate archives. `index.json` records each crate version, crate VCS commit, exact upstream URL and SHA-256. Packaging verifies those fields against the restored crate metadata and includes the unchanged text in the candidate notices.

The objc2 text is its upstream licensing statement, including its SDK-derived-code discussion; it is retained verbatim rather than replaced with a generic license template. Final publication/source/license review remains in the release ledger.
